axes.name: open_update_form
axes.rationale: The target compares the current bit to selected before changing it; compare the exact changed-bit XOR with direct masked assignment.

axes.name: closed_update_form
axes.rationale: The closed path performs the same bit-2 state update without redrawing; test the target XOR form and equivalent masked assignment.

axes.name: bitmap_state_index
axes.rationale: The target indexes the words at object offsets +0x28 and +0x2a via a scaled index of one or two from base +0x26. Compare equivalent C condition spellings.

spec.semantic_summary: Set bit 2 to the requested value even when the window is closed; redraw after a change by type, and redraw only bitmap objects when unchanged.
binding_evidence: Packet names direct globals clipDC, win_hwnd, monoPat, __backColor and __foreColor; type/state and far-call references are at the offsets in packet.md.
